liverpool_h1_0.text: Alright, la! Come in, kettle's on. 'Boss' means brilliant. 'Made up' means delighted. 'Scran' means food.
Scouse the stew gave its name to the people and the accent. Same word, bigger flavour.

then.text: You have had your bowl, la. Ta-ra now.

else.text: Take a bowl for the road. Lamb, spuds and carrots. Do not tell my mam it is not hers.
